scope: read-only source/design review; no runtime rerun by Claude

findings.patch:
--- a/src/ui/agent_trace_panel.gd
+++ b/src/ui/agent_trace_panel.gd
@@ -92,2 +92,3 @@
 
-	var actions: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
+	# Manual actions wrap onto more rows instead of clipping at large text sizes.
+	var actions: HFlowContainer = HFlowContainer.new()
 	_enable_button = _action_button("Enable", "Mount the virtual camera on the current robot.", actions)
@@ -102,24 +103,25 @@
 	content.add_child(_section("Goal"))
-	var goal_row: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
+	# Field, disclosure and Run stack at full width; provider, data and limits precede Run in scroll order.
 	_goal_field = LineEdit.new()
 	# Learner text stays raw; text_submitted is left unconnected so Enter never sends it.
 	_goal_field.max_length = GOAL_MAX_CHARS
 	_goal_field.auto_translate_mode = Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED
 	_goal_field.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
 	_goal_field.text_changed.connect(_on_goal_text_changed)
-	goal_row.add_child(_goal_field)
-	_run_button = SsokTheme.button("Run with AI")
-	_run_button.tooltip_text = "Send this goal to the connected AI operator."
-	_run_button.pressed.connect(_on_run_pressed)
-	goal_row.add_child(_run_button)
-	content.add_child(goal_row)
-	_goal_status_label = _dynamic_label()
-	content.add_child(_goal_status_label)
-	# Provider, data and limits sit beside Run so they are seen before the first request.
+	content.add_child(_goal_field)
 	var disclosure: Label = _dynamic_label(&"SectionLabel")
-	SsokLocale.bind(disclosure, "Run with AI sends this goal to the connected operator, which requests %s from OpenAI with its existing Codex ChatGPT login. Sent: the goal, camera PNGs, public frame context, short visual summaries and tool results.", [GOAL_MODEL])
+	SsokLocale.bind(disclosure, "Run with AI asks the connected operator to request %s from OpenAI with its existing Codex ChatGPT login. Sent: the goal, camera PNGs, public frame context, short summaries and tool results.", [GOAL_MODEL])
 	content.add_child(disclosure)
 	var limits: Label = _dynamic_label(&"SectionLabel")
-	SsokLocale.bind(limits, "Per run: up to %d actions, %d camera frames and %d seconds. Usage counts toward that ChatGPT account; the CLI sets no fixed cost or request cap.", [GOAL_MAX_ACTIONS, GOAL_MAX_FRAMES, GOAL_TIME_LIMIT])
+	SsokLocale.bind(limits, "Per run: up to %d actions, %d images and %d seconds. Usage counts toward that ChatGPT account, with no fixed cost or model-request cap.", [GOAL_MAX_ACTIONS, GOAL_MAX_FRAMES, GOAL_TIME_LIMIT])
 	content.add_child(limits)
+	_run_button = SsokTheme.button("Run with AI")
+	_run_button.clip_text = false
+	_run_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_run_button.tooltip_text = "Send this goal to the connected AI operator."
+	_run_button.pressed.connect(_on_run_pressed)
+	content.add_child(_run_button)
+	_goal_status_label = _dynamic_label()
+	content.add_child(_goal_status_label)
 
@@ -405,6 +407,8 @@
-func _action_button(text: String, tip: String, row: HBoxContainer) -> Button:
+func _action_button(text: String, tip: String, row: Container) -> Button:
 	var control: Button = SsokTheme.button(text)
 	control.tooltip_text = tip
+	# Full labels set the minimum width so the flow row wraps rather than truncating.
+	control.clip_text = false
 	control.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
 	row.add_child(control)
 	return control

new_english_strings.en: Run with AI asks the connected operator to request %s from OpenAI with its existing Codex ChatGPT login. Sent: the goal, camera PNGs, public frame context, short summaries and tool results.
new_english_strings.ko: AI로 실행하면 연결된 운영자가 기존 Codex ChatGPT 로그인으로 OpenAI에 %s을(를) 요청합니다. 전송: 목표, 카메라 PNG, 공개 프레임 정보, 짧은 요약, 도구 결과.
new_english_strings.zh_CN: 用 AI 运行会让已连接的操作程序使用其现有的 Codex ChatGPT 登录向 OpenAI 请求 %s。发送内容：目标、摄像头 PNG、公开帧信息、简短摘要和工具结果。
new_english_strings.ja: AIで実行すると、接続中のオペレーターが既存の Codex ChatGPT ログインで OpenAI に %s をリクエストします。送信内容: 目標、カメラ PNG、公開フレーム情報、短い要約、ツール結果。

new_english_strings.en: Per run: up to %d actions, %d images and %d seconds. Usage counts toward that ChatGPT account, with no fixed cost or model-request cap.
new_english_strings.ko: 실행당 최대 동작 %d회, 이미지 %d장, %d초. 사용량은 해당 ChatGPT 계정에 포함되며 고정 비용이나 모델 요청 한도는 없습니다.
new_english_strings.zh_CN: 每次运行：最多 %d 个动作、%d 张图像、%d 秒。用量计入该 ChatGPT 账户，没有固定费用或模型请求上限。
new_english_strings.ja: 1回の実行: 最大 %d 回の操作、%d 枚の画像、%d 秒。使用量はその ChatGPT アカウントに計上され、固定費用やモデルリクエストの上限はありません。

findings.notes: Goal block is now stacked: field, disclosure, limits, full-width Run (clip_text off), then status, so all provider/data/limit facts precede the single Run click in scroll order. The manual action row is an HFlowContainer with unclipped buttons, so it wraps at 200% instead of truncating. The old disclosure and limits English keys become unused and can be retired. Hunk 3 line numbers are estimated; apply with offset tolerance. Pinned Stop, 4:3 preview, raw goal, SHA disclaimer and theme usage are unchanged. Not visually verified: revised captures (all 24) are required before any pass claim, especially Run and action-row widths at compact 200%.
